decisionsTitle: The next event says how far away it is
changelogLine: - **The calendar's «Următorul eveniment» says how far away it is** — «Azi», «Mâine», «Peste 5 zile», «Peste 3 săptămâni», «Peste 2 luni», «Acum», in calendar days on the club's clock, with an hourglass under the date; no extra database read, the page already rolls at midnight. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the calendar with «Tema v2» on and a next event, then the card under the date carries a line with a glyph saying how far away it is in calendar days on the club's clock: «Acum» once it has started, «Azi» the same day, «Mâine», «Peste 2» to «Peste 13 zile», «Peste 2» to «Peste 8 săptămâni» from fourteen days, «Peste 2 luni» from sixty days (in English «Now», «Today», «Tomorrow», «In 5 days», «In 3 weeks», «In 2 months», Romanian's three plural forms by `countForm`); the clocks changing on the last Sunday of October moves no step, and the static page is held to the club's midnight and to the event's start so the words never outlive their day. Proven by `tests/unit/events/next-event-away.test.ts` (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
